milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The trapped chest is at spawn-relative (1, 1, 6) inside the front room of the structure. The player must approach within 8 blocks and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the trapped chest'. Max distance of 8 is generous since the player spawns ~6 blocks away and must walk forward slightly. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually looking at the chest.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task — when dark oak stairs are mined with an axe, they drop as items that enter the player's inventory. The player needs to mine at least 1 dark_oak_stairs block from the 9×3 wall (27 total blocks) to begin creating an opening. We require min_count=1 since even a single mined stair confirms the player has started breaking through the barrier. The item ID for the drop is 'dark_oak_stairs'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange banner is at spawn-relative (1, 1, 12) in the hidden back room behind the dark oak stairs wall. The player must navigate through the mined opening in the stairs wall and approach within 5 blocks while facing the banner. Max distance of 5 ensures the player has actually passed through the wall (the wall is at Z=9, banner at Z=12, so from the front room the minimum distance would be >5 through the solid wall). Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at the banner.
